inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped run report counts distinct composite run identities with COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(...)), counts successful and failed states with conditional SUM(CASE ...), and computes minimum, maximum, and average durations with a fixed end-time fallback.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a service-run metrics report with new names, rows, and integer ticks. The BigQuery CONCAT and timestamp-difference forms are translated to MariaDB-compatible CONCAT and fixed tick subtraction; an open run uses a deterministic COALESCE fallback instead of the source's current timestamp.

fixture_notes: Alpha has three distinct run tokens, two successful and one failed; the open third run uses fixed fallback tick 200. Beta has two distinct runs, one successful and one failed. Durations are derived from end_tick or the fixed fallback, and the composite CONCAT identity is counted distinctly per service.
determinism_notes: Service codes, run tokens, states, ticks, fallback value, aggregate expressions, grouping key, and ordering are fixed. No current timestamps, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE service_runs (run_id INT PRIMARY KEY, service_code VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, run_token VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, run_state VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, start_tick INT NOT NULL, end_tick INT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT service_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(service_code, '-', run_token)) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN run_state = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN run_state = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_runs, MIN(COALESCE(end_tick, 200) - start_tick) AS min_duration_ticks, MAX(COALESCE(end_tick, 200) - start_tick) AS max_duration_ticks, AVG(COALESCE(end_tick, 200) - start_tick) AS avg_duration_ticks FROM service_runs GROUP BY service_code ORDER BY service_code

checks.sql: SELECT run_id, service_code, run_token, run_state, start_tick, end_tick FROM service_runs ORDER BY run_id
